title: Special-Order Deposit Rate by Comfort Club Scheduling Priority — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, the deposit rate on a special-order part follows the scheduling priority of the customer's active tier under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. The record read is the agreement's status and the scheduling priority of its tier: standard, priority or front of line.

**Rule.** The deposit rate is 25 percent for a customer whose active Comfort Club tier schedules front of line. It is 35 percent for a customer whose active tier schedules with priority. For every other customer it is the class's special-order parts deposit percentage of 50 percent.

| Customer | Deposit rate on the parts amount |
|---|---|
| Active tier scheduling front of line | 25 percent |
| Active tier scheduling with priority | 35 percent |
| Active tier at standard scheduling, or no active agreement | 50 percent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical $386.00 parts amount, before any other change to the rate)

| Customer | Deposit |
|---|---|
| Front of line | $96.50 |
| Priority | $135.10 |
| Everyone else | $193.00 |
